Everything you need

One quiet app that runs the back office.

Instant Booking Records

Send a message like "Rahul, 3 nights from 15 June, ₹8,000 total, ₹3,000 advance" — Chakrio parses it and logs the booking automatically.

Cancellation Tracking

Chakrio extracts refund amounts and advance retained from cancellation messages and updates your records in real time.

Expense Logging

Type "pool service ₹500" or "plumber ₹1,200" — Chakrio logs the expense instantly. No dropdowns, no category hunting.

Monthly P&L Reports

On the 1st of each month, get a full P&L — total revenue, all expenses, and net profit — sent straight to your phone.

OTA Calendar Sync

Connect iCal feeds from any OTA. Blocked dates flow in automatically — your availability is always accurate, double bookings eliminated.

Guest Experience Automation

Chakrio auto-sends booking confirmations, pre-arrival payment reminders, mid-stay care messages, and post-checkout review requests.

WhatsApp & Telegram

Your team keeps using WhatsApp or Telegram. No new app required. Chakrio works inside the chat tool you already have open all day.

Guest Re-engagement Campaigns

Send WhatsApp broadcasts to past guests — seasonal offers, festival availability, or a personalised "we miss you" message. Track delivery in real time.

Direct WhatsApp Bookings

Guests book you directly on WhatsApp — no OTA, no 15–20% commission. Every enquiry is tracked: dates requested, outcome, and source.

Guest Experience

Keep guests engaged — automatically

Chakrio sends the right message at the right moment, without you lifting a finger.

Every guest who books through Chakrio is automatically enrolled in a touchpoint sequence — from the instant confirmation to the post-checkout review ask.

No templates to set up. No scheduling. No extra app. You just log the booking and Chakrio handles every message at exactly the right time.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Chakrio.

I already use a spreadsheet — why do I need this?+

Spreadsheets work, but they require you to open them, find the right tab, and type every field manually — every single booking. With Chakrio, you just send a message in plain language and the record is created automatically. No switching apps, no formatting, no errors from fat-fingering a date.

What if I have multiple properties?+

Chakrio supports multiple properties under one account. Each property has its own booking records and dashboard. You can switch between them instantly from the same login.

What types of properties can use Chakrio?+

Chakrio is built for dharmshalas (built for pilgrim-town operations — group arrivals, festival rush, and high-volume bookings), boutique hotels, villas, homestays, guesthouses, B&Bs, and vacation rentals. It works for single-property owners and those managing multiple properties. Our first clients include Raghuleela Dham (60 rooms, Goverdhan) and Niva — The Rooted Heaven (Udaipur).

Does Chakrio work outside India?+

WhatsApp works globally, so the bot can receive messages from any country. However, payments (Razorpay), phone number handling, and our onboarding team are currently India-first. If you're based outside India, contact us and we'll advise.

Do I need technical knowledge to use Chakrio?+

None at all. If you can send a text message, you can use Chakrio. You simply type bookings in natural language — the AI handles the rest.

How do I get started?+

We onboard every property personally. Contact us via WhatsApp and we'll get your booking bot live — usually within 24 hours.

How long does setup take?+

Most properties are live within 24 hours of contacting us. We handle the entire setup — bot configuration, dashboard access, and a walkthrough with your team. You don't need to do anything technical.

What if I send a wrong message or make a mistake?+

Just send a correction. For example: "Update Alex check-out to 18th June." Chakrio will find the booking and update it. If you need to cancel, just say so — the bot handles updates, cancellations, and corrections the same way it handles new bookings.
